name: Low Pressure Introduction

structure_blocks.label: Greeting
structure_blocks.guidance: Use approved contact context when available, otherwise use a neutral greeting.

structure_blocks.label: Source-backed observation
structure_blocks.guidance: Open with one approved company or opportunity signal and keep source attribution available.

structure_blocks.label: Keystone relevance
structure_blocks.guidance: Connect only to approved Keystone positioning and avoid unsupported claims.

structure_blocks.label: Soft CTA
structure_blocks.guidance: Close with a low-pressure compare notes question.

good_for: first-touch outreach from approved research context
clinical AI, evidence generation, or research operations prospects
avoid_when: source-backed company or opportunity context is missing
legal, financial, security, patient-specific, or contractual advice is requested
